verdict.rationale: The Browser Actions guide says Scrape can click, scroll, or "wait" before capturing a page and then report which interactions succeeded, so pre-capture waiting exists. The evidence never says the wait can target a specific CSS selector rather than a fixed delay. The CSS-selector mention elsewhere refers to extracting fields, not waiting. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a wait-for-selector parameter, details on selector wait timeouts and failure behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
